name: pi-skills
title_zh: 给 pi 编码代理装一整套即插即用的技能库
tagline_zh: 在 pi、Claude Code、Codex CLI 之间无缝复用技能。不用再为每个代理重写提示词，装一次，到处跑。
tagline_en: Reuse skills across pi, Claude Code, and Codex CLI. Write once, run anywhere — no more per-agent prompt rewriting.
desc_en: Skills for pi coding agent (compatible with Claude Code and Codex CLI)
why_zh: 按代理无关的格式打包技能，靠统一约定而非硬编码适配。换工具链时，技能文件原样迁移，零改动。
why_en: Skills are packaged in an agent-agnostic format, relying on conventions rather than hardcoded adapters. Migrate as-is when.
limit_zh: 仅适用于支持 skills 目录约定的代理（pi、Claude Code、Codex CLI）。不含任何内置技能。
limit_en: Only for agents supporting the skills-dir convention (pi, Claude Code, Codex CLI). No built-in skills; you must author or import them. Outside these.
